result.summary: Found 1 visual issue. The main page content appears intact; partial off-screen carousel items and bottom content cut-off are ignored per instructions.

issues.description: A thick dark horizontal bar is overlaid across the bottom navigation area, crossing through the search and bookmark icons. This makes the navigation look visually broken and may interfere with tapping or recognizing the icons.
issues.suggestion: Move the system/home indicator or overlay below the bottom navigation using proper safe-area spacing, or ensure the bottom nav is rendered above/below it without overlap.
